body_html:
Portable Folding Camping Toilet – Compact Potty, Caravan Toilet, for Picnic & Fishing
Features:
*Easily folds away when not in use, saving space and making it easy to carry. Suitable for camping, fishing, travel, etc.
*70 reinforced load‑bearing buckles combined with high‑strength PP material. Static load capacity up to 400 lbs. Features an anti‑spread locking design and a high‑friction base. Very sturdy – no worries about breakage.
*Can be used not only as a toilet but also as a trash can, stool, storage box, vomit bucket, etc., meeting various outdoor needs.
*Easy to use – quick and simple to install, no tools required, no complicated steps.
*Please use on a flat surface. Avoid shaking, tilting, or stepping on it.

Specifications:
Name: Folding Toilet Stool
Material: PP
Color: Black
Dimensions: 31 × 30.5 × 34.5 cm
Weight: 1.36 kg
Load Capacity: 181.5 kg (400 lbs)
Applicable Scenarios: Outdoor

Package Includes:
1 × Portable toilet
1 × Roll of garbage bags
1 × Storage bag
